title: 5.10 Café Mission
unit_outcome: Express simple food preferences and needs and complete a supported purchase or café order.
goal: Complete a supported café visit by identifying an item, stating a preference or need, ordering, understanding a price, and responding politely.
review_vocabulary: selected Unit 5 vocabulary and all service chunks
grammar_function: Integrated Unit 5 performance using only controlled choices, completion, listening selection, and model-repeat speaking.
prerequisite: 5.9 review readiness met or targeted review completed.
speaking_outcome: Repeat six mission-critical utterances: greeting, preference, need, request, price question, and thanks.

cards.pedagogy_note: Mission orientation uses reviewed target language, not a new procedural instruction.
Mission orientation retrieves the exact taught price question.
Mission preview uses only taught transaction chunks; no assessment.
Need versus want has decisive context.
Both choices are taught, but only the price question can apply to this non-person task.
Speaker roles make only the learner's gratitude response valid.
Integrated count+color+item request; every distractor is a valid known phrase and fails one feature.
Full multi-feature order; all fruit separated.
Generic proven instruction; scene establishes mission step 1.
Only please forms the taught request; removes the contextually possible elliptical Juice, thank you.
Mission acceptance; context shows decision to buy.
Speaker-role contrast removes a plausible additional order.
Final integrated quantity request; exact count visible.
